blurb: Guests rent various watercraft including powerboats, pontoons, Sea-Doos, stand up paddleboards, and kayaks to explore Okanagan Lake. Rentals include safety equipment and temporary boating licenses at no cost. The rental location is at the Summerland Waterfront Resort dock, with boats available from late June to mid-September.
extraNote: Fuel is an additional charge for motorized rentals · Prices subject to change for holidays · Rates do not include GST/PST · Dock at Summerland Waterfront Resort · End of June to mid-September
